SDG indicators for the forcibly displaced

Comparable SDG indicators for refugees, IDPs and stateless people, from GAIN-example data — government-produced where possible, data year 2018 onward. Indicators are read against the 14 priority SDG indicators in EGRISS Methodological Paper 3 (Oct 2024); a ◆ marks a priority indicator. Hover a country for its cards — grouped by population, tagged with source, producer, year and host.

In support of the Sustainable Development Goals · EGRISS · GAIN
27 countries · 110 SDG values (63 on priority indicators) · 12 of 14 priority indicators. Comparable SDG indicators for refugees, IDPs and stateless people, drawn from GAIN examples — government-produced where possible, data year 2018 onward (post-IRRS). Values are computed from microdata, extracted from official reports, or estimated (labelled per card). Empty countries have data in hand or need a custom tabulation — the outreach list is ready.
